postal_system.assignment_rule: The MTC administers the Código Postal Nacional. Official guidance updated in January 2024 says the code has five digits and is based on location. MTC technical material defines digits one and two as department or postal region, digit three as a road-network routing zone and digits four and five as postal district, locality, populated centre or urban concentration. A valid string, prefix, example, Ubigeo, locality, coordinate or synthetic fixture is not proof of a current assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The official lookup labels geographic boundaries as referential. The 2018 public MTC XLSX is official dated assignment data under an Open Data Commons Attribution licence but is not a polygon release. No reusable current nationwide official postcode polygon artifact has been verified for this seed. Retain a non-geometric routing/locality object unless exact rights-cleared, time-compatible MTC assignment and service-area evidence passes review; IGN, INEI, GeoVivienda, COFOPRI, OSM, parcels, buffers, interpolation, Voronoi and models cannot become official MTC postcode geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, thoroughfare type and name, number or S/N, block, lot, building or premises, floor, apartment/office/interior, urbanization or settlement, reference or point of interest, locality or populated centre, district, province, department or Constitutional Province, P.O. Box and five-digit postcode separately. Official examples, public viewers and synthetic fixtures are not production address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as department_or_postal_region, routing_zone, postal_district, locality, populated_centre, urban_concentration, route, po_box, organization, service_area or unknown. A locality point, district polygon, lookup result or routing label is not automatically a full-code polygon.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a rights-cleared stable civic-address identifier, an explicit reviewed relation to a permitted COFOPRI, municipal or other construction identifier, and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, edition, validity, privacy, CRS and digest. A postcode, route, point of interest, reference, locality, parcel, coordinate, containment, interpolation or proximity is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: INEI Ubigeo identifies department, province and district and IGN supplies referential boundaries and populated-centre context. Preserve edition, code, producer, scale, source-defined status, licence, CRS and digest. Administrative and statistical identities or polygons remain distinct from MTC postal assignment and geometry.
postal_system.cadastre_and_building_rule: GeoVivienda and COFOPRI Geo Llaqta or WMS may expose housing, urban, street, lot, block and construction context with source-specific coverage. Viewer access, public-domain service language or cadastral authority does not establish nationwide completeness, owner-data publication permission, postal assignment or an exact civic-address-to-building relation. Pin the exact layer, jurisdiction, access and reuse terms, stable identifier, vintage, CRS, privacy classification and digest.
postal_system.designated_operator_rule: UPU identifies SERPOST as Peru designated operator, while MTC administers the national postcode system. Institutional status and general mailing guidance are context; they do not by themselves create a current assignment row, reusable address corpus, polygon or building link.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Permitted MTC release rows and lookup observations plus rights-cleared INEI, IGN, GeoVivienda, COFOPRI and community evidence may normalize input, validate strict joins, rank candidates, compress reviewed geometry, build indexes, detect drift and generate mathematical or machine-learning review surfaces. Every output preserves source version, release and input digests, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and official-release, official-observation or derived-review status. It never fills unknown coverage or invents a street, number, unit, building, person or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate dated MTC release rows, time-bound official observations, typed routing/locality objects, reviewed derived service areas, permitted civic addresses, explicit address-to-building relations and administrative context to AGID cells without relabelling source objects or claiming AGID geometry is official Peruvian postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The 2018 MTC dataset catalog records Open Data Commons Attribution and public access; pin the exact file, release page, licence snapshot, attribution, schema and digest before use. Current lookup automation, caching and redistribution require separate terms review. IGN and INEI open-data releases, GeoVivienda and COFOPRI layers, UPU publications and ODbL content retain separate obligations and partitions.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO PE scope and stores department, Constitutional Province, province, district, postal routing, locality, populated-centre, urban, cadastral, maritime, border and source-specific territorial representations independently. Postal, administrative, statistical, cadastral, address, construction and AGID coverage, legal status and vintage must not be conflated, silently extended or used to resolve sovereignty or boundary status.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, references, points of interest, numbers, blocks, lots, interiors, coordinates, lookup queries, cadastral records, owners, recipients, organizations, credentials and logs can expose household, property, security or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review; exclude private, owner-linked and query data from public artifacts.
postal_system.temporal_rule: MTC assignments and observations, the 2018 open dataset, 2011 legal framework, 2017 technical structure, INEI Ubigeo editions, IGN releases, GeoVivienda and COFOPRI layers, derived surfaces, building relations and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, service and artifact version, edition, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: A Hugging Face Dataset may publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet or GeoParquet partitions with exact attribution, release, jurisdiction, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. Real addresses, references, MTC query logs, fine cadastral or owner-linked data, credentials and restricted inputs stay private, gated or external. Dataset Viewer is discovery, a Space is demonstration and production AGID readers pin a Hub commit and verify shard digests.
